chunks: We are deferring it only for a time ordained.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God delays matters only for a 'time ordained'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Ajal al-Ma'dud' (the fixed term), illustrating that divine delay is never arbitrary but strictly bound by a preordained measure, reflecting God's absolute sovereignty over time. It serves as a reminder that the postponement of punishment or decree is a manifestation of mercy and precision, ensuring that every event occurs exactly at its destined moment without deviation.
